items.text: festival = festival
items.picture: A sunny July afternoon: Emma, Lucia and Tomáš, rucksacks on their backs, come over a low hill and look down at the festival by the lake: a meadow by the water with woods all round, the main stage at the water's edge, a big white main tent, a smaller theatre tent, a row of food stalls and a campsite of small tents, with crowds of young people everywhere.

items.text: Máš chvíľu? = Have you got a minute?
items.picture: Split picture of a phone call. Left: in the dorm room, Lucia, a colourful festival flyer in her other hand, phones her friend, bubbling with excitement. Right: Emma, at a café table on the sunny Danube embankment, answers her phone, curious.

items.text: Lucia phones Emma. How does she ask if Emma has a minute?
koncert = concert
items.picture: Night at the festival by the lake: a rock band plays on the lit main stage at the water's edge, a singer, two guitarists and a drummer under coloured spotlights. In the cheering crowd in front, Marek punches the air and sings along at the top of his voice, Emma and Lucia dancing beside him.

items.text: kapela = band
stan = tent
items.picture: At the festival campsite by the lake, Emma helps Tomáš put up the friends' big orange tent: she holds a pole upright while he kneels and hammers in a peg, other small tents and the water behind them.

items.text: spacák a karimatka = sleeping bag and sleeping mat
items.picture: In the dorm room, Lucia hands Emma her rolled-up sleeping bag and Tomáš holds out a rolled-up sleeping mat; Emma, her arms full, thanks them with a big smile.

items.text: Lucia suggests going together. What does she say?
predpoveď počasia = weather forecast
items.picture: At Emma's desk in the dorm room, Emma and Lucia lean towards the laptop, where a weather forecast is open: a map of Slovakia covered with little sun, cloud and rain symbols for the weekend. Emma scrolls; Lucia points at a cloud.

items.text: surfovať po internete = to surf the internet
polooblačno = partly cloudy
najvyššia teplota = the highest temperature
Čo sú prehánky? = What are showers?
items.picture: A sun shower at the festival campsite: the sun shines over the lake while a short burst of rain falls from one small grey cloud, a rainbow over the water. By the big orange tent, Emma holds out her palm to the drops, puzzled; Lucia laughs and explains.

items.text: Emma asks: Čo sú prehánky? What does Lucia answer?
Neboj sa! = Don't worry!
items.picture: In the dorm room, Emma stands at the window looking out at heavy grey clouds, worried, her fingers crossed on both hands; Lucia puts an arm round her shoulders and smiles reassuringly.

items.text: Emma is worried about the rain. What does Lucia tell her?
dúfať = to hope
baliť sa = to pack
items.picture: In the dorm room, Emma packs for the festival: a big hiking rucksack stands open on her bed among piles of clothes, a torch and a water bottle, and she stuffs in a jumper, ticking off a blank packing list held in her teeth.

items.text: ruksak = rucksack
dáždnik a pršiplášť = umbrella and raincoat
items.picture: At the dormitory entrance on a drizzly morning, Lucia, already in a bright yellow raincoat with the hood up, hands Emma a folded umbrella as they set off with their rucksacks.

items.text: zobrať si = to take (with you)
požičať = to lend
Emma has no sleeping bag. What does Lucia say?
program = programme
items.picture: At the festival entrance, Emma, Lucia and Tomáš study a big programme poster on a wooden board: rows of blank boxes, each with a little drawing of a guitar, a saxophone, a theatre mask or a camera. Lucia points at one box and turns to Emma.

items.text: pódium = stage
items.picture: Afternoon at the festival: the main stage at the water's edge, the lake shining behind it. A crew sets up amplifiers, a drum kit and lights on the empty stage, while Emma and Lucia watch from the grass in front.

items.text: tvorivá dielňa = workshop
items.picture: Inside the big white main tent at the festival, a music workshop: people sit in a circle with instruments while a young teacher shows a chord on her guitar. Emma frowns in concentration over her first chord, and Tomáš, beside her, plays a drum kit with gusto.

items.text: Kam by si išla? = Where would you go?
Lucia asks Emma: Kam by si išla? What can Emma answer?
Čo keby sme…? = How about…?
Páčil sa ti koncert? = Did you like the concert?
items.picture: Late at night, Emma and Lucia walk back from the main stage to the tents with torches, the lit stage behind them. Emma, glowing, asks Lucia something eagerly; Lucia wrinkles her nose and tilts a flat hand: so-so.

items.text: Nebolo to zlé. = It wasn't bad.
Som fanúšik rocku. = I'm a rock fan.
Marek loves rock. What does he say?
rock, folk, džez = rock, folk, jazz
items.picture: Three small scenes side by side. Left: a rock band with electric guitars, the singer leaning into the microphone. Middle: a folk duo on hay bales, one with an acoustic guitar, one with a fiddle. Right: a jazz trio with a saxophone, a piano and a double bass in soft blue light.

items.text: hrať na bubnoch = to play the drums
reportérka = reporter
items.picture: Near the main stage at the festival, Martina, the student radio reporter, holds her microphone out to Emma, who answers a little shyly; festival-goers stroll past behind them.

items.text: The reporter asks Emma: Čo ste videli na festivale? What can Emma answer?
Mám pre teba zlú správu. = I've got bad news for you.
items.picture: At the festival campsite, Lucia walks up to Emma with her phone in her hand and a long face, bringing bad news; Emma, hearing it, clutches her head with both hands in disbelief.

items.text: zrušiť = to cancel
items.picture: At the festival entrance, an organiser in a hi-vis vest with a walkie-talkie sticks a big red cross over the evening concert on the programme poster; the fans around him groan. Emma steps up to him politely to ask him something.

items.text: To nemôže byť pravda! = That can't be true!
búrka = storm
items.picture: A storm breaks over the festival by the lake on a Saturday afternoon: black clouds, a fork of lightning over the water, rain lashing down and wind bending the trees and flattening the tents. Festival-goers run for the big white main tent; Emma and Lucia dash after them, clutching their hoods.

items.text: zápcha na diaľnici = traffic jam on the motorway
items.picture: A long, unmoving queue of cars on the motorway, blue flashing lights of a crash far ahead. Tomáš, at the wheel of his old dark-blue estate car with the roof box, drums his fingers on the steering wheel and checks his watch, fed up.

items.text: Prepáčte, mohla by som sa vás na niečo spýtať? = Excuse me, could I ask you something?
Emma asks one of the organisers why. What does she say?
hrom a blesk = thunder and lightning
vietor = wind
slnko a dážď = sun and rain
sneh a mráz = snow and frost
obliecť si = to put on (clothes)
bunda a kabát = jacket and coat
items.picture: In the dorm room at the open wardrobe, Emma holds up a short sporty jacket in one hand and a long warm winter coat in the other, deciding which to pack; Lucia, on her bed, points at the jacket.

items.text: šaty = dress
items.picture: Evening at the festival campsite: Emma steps out of the big orange tent in a new summer dress, ready for the show in the theatre tent, and does a little twirl; Lucia gives her a thumbs-up.

items.text: šortky = shorts
items.picture: A hot morning at the festival campsite: Emma crawls out of the big orange tent in denim shorts and a T-shirt, bare-legged, squinting up at the blazing sun.

items.text: šiltovka = baseball cap
items.picture: Blazing midday sun over the festival meadow: Tomáš, sweating, pulls a baseball cap down low over his eyes and puts on sunglasses.

items.text: It's hot and sunny at the festival. What does Emma put on?
rolák = polo neck
Lucia wants to know what Emma will wear to the theatre. What does she ask?
čiapka = hat
items.picture: A cold night by the lake: by a small campfire outside the big orange tent, Emma, in a polo-neck jumper, pulls on a warm woolly hat while Lucia wraps a scarf round her neck; their breath steams in the air.

items.text: topánky a tenisky = shoes and trainers
sandále a čižmy = sandals and boots
items.picture: The festival campsite after the rain, all mud and puddles: Lucia stomps happily through the mud in rubber boots, while Emma, in sandals, stands stuck in a muddy puddle, looking down at her feet in dismay.

items.text: sako a kravata = blazer and tie
items.picture: In a corridor at Tomáš's company, Emma, in a smart blazer, walks to a meeting beside pán Hudák, who straightens his burgundy tie; Tomáš, in his grey hoodie and no tie, grins at them from his office door.

items.text: vyskúšať si = to try on
items.picture: In a shoe shop, shelves of shoes and trainers on every wall: Emma sits on a low bench pulling on a boot, its partner in the open box beside her, while a young shop assistant waits to see if it fits.

items.text: In a shop, Emma wants to try on some boots. What does she ask?
Vonku je chladno. = It's chilly outside.
pod nulou = below zero
piknik = picnic
items.picture: A sunny day: Emma, Lucia, Tomáš and Marek have a picnic on a checked blanket in a meadow above the lake, with a basket, bread, cheese, fruit and a thermos; Marek hands round sandwiches.

items.text: škaredo = horrible (weather)
items.picture: Horrible weather by the lake: cold rain blows sideways in a strong wind, the tents flap and the trees bend. Emma's umbrella has blown inside out, and Lucia, beside her, clutches her hood with both hands.

items.text: It's cold and windy, and it's raining. What do you say?
Marek has to work on Friday, so he can't come. What does he say?
príspevok = post
items.picture: In the big orange tent, Lucia posts a photo from the festival: on her phone screen, a picture of the four friends by the lake with a little heart under it. Emma leans over her shoulder to look.

items.text: Emma wants to send her mum a short message from her phone. What is it called?
nuda = boredom
items.picture: A rainy morning in the big orange tent: rain streams down past the open door, and Lucia lies on her back on her sleeping bag, staring up at the tent roof, bored stiff.

items.text: It has rained all morning, and Lucia is bored. What does she say?
kocka a figúrka = dice and counter
items.picture: In the big orange tent while it rains outside, Emma, Lucia and Tomáš play a board game on a sleeping bag: Emma throws the dice, and the others lean in to watch, little coloured counters on the board.

items.text: naspamäť = by heart
items.picture: At the festival information tent, Emma holds up her dead phone, its screen black, and frowns hard, trying to remember a number; a friendly young man at the counter holds out his own phone to her.

items.text: Emma asks a stranger at the information tent to lend her a phone. What does she say?
You'd like to suggest the jazz night to your friends. What do you say?
